entities.name: Al-Lālakāʾī
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hibatullah ibn al-Hasan ibn Mansour al-Tabari, Abu al-Qasim al-Razi, al-Shafi’i, al-Lalaka'i al-Amoli or Hibatullah Lalika'i was an Iranian hadith scholar, theologian, hafiz and Shafi'i jurist. His most famous teacher was Abu Ishaq al-Isfarayini and his most famous disciple was Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.
